paragraphs.dominant_move: containment-construction: Last contact and aircraft trajectories can define a bounded probability field. -> creates the spatial search input -> moves from where the plane may be to whether a search detects it
detection-to-action: Imperfect detection should alter both retained probability and the next searched neighbor. -> creates an iterative search loop -> moves to the assumptions and transfer properties

scope-and-transfer: The procedure is parameterized across plane types but only inside explicit physical assumptions. -> states strengths and the operating boundary -> the Introduction must justify the sparse-prior need
observation-gap: Transoceanic flights become hard to locate beyond coastal radar. -> defines the missing-observation trigger -> contrasts prior-information cases

case-contrast: Bayesian search is most useful when incident evidence can eliminate zones, while sparse priors leave a harder problem. -> isolates the unmet sparse-prior case -> states a new model objective

objective: A signal-less flight with indefinite casualty time and possible IFP deviation needs a time-efficient mathematical search plan. -> commits the paper to an end-to-end procedure -> Section 2 decomposes the procedure

global_organization_chain: offshore observation gap and sparse-prior motivation
Only after the positive language, organization, model, and visual chain is complete does G7 record algebra, support, unit, update, caption, implementation, validation, and scope warnings.

moves: input: A transoceanic flight beyond coastal radar, a last communication on the intended path, sparse prior evidence, and finite search resources.
rhetorical job: Preview the complete model as a positive construction from containment through detection and updating before assumptions and transfer limits.
analytical job: Name the casualty-distance density, glide/deviation field, POC cells, Koopman POD, nondetection update, neighborhood search, Flight ABCD example, sensitivity, and strengths.
output: A conditional promise that a source-parameterized, continuously updated neighborhood plan can prioritize a bounded search region.
handoff: The contents and introduction unpack the observation gap, model stages, evaluation, worked example, communication artifact, and code.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The abstract's containment-detection-search promise.
rhetorical job: Make the entire analytical route visible, including sensitivity, limitations, public communication, and computational appendices.
analytical job: Order Introduction; containment, discretization, coordinates, POD, updating, assumptions, sensitivity, evaluation; Flight ABCD; conclusion; press summary; Appendices A-D.
output: A source-heading map that keeps each model interface and evidence artifact distinct.
handoff: The Introduction supplies the offshore observation problem and sparse-prior motivation.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: Eighty-three vanished aircraft, limited offshore radar, scheduled pilot communication, and contrasting Air France/MH370 evidence histories.
rhetorical job: Establish why a new search model is needed when familiar Bayesian elimination lacks strong incident-specific priors.
analytical job: Connect radar loss to communication triggers; contrast informative versus sparse priors; require indefinite casualty timing, deviation from the IFP, no signal, and time efficiency.
output: A sparse-prior missing-flight search objective with explicit trajectory and time priorities.
handoff: The model overview decomposes that objective into containment, detection, and iterative priority updates.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: A flight traveling linearly from A to B whose location and detectability are unknown after last contact.
rhetorical job: Give the reader a three-part interface before any probability density or algorithm is introduced.
analytical job: Separate containment, conditional detection under resource conservation, and continuously updated most-likely location.
output: A containment -> detection -> updating decomposition for an optimized search plan.
handoff: Section 2.1 first constructs the spatial probability field.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: Last-contact distance and coordinates, remaining route to coastal radar, aircraft altitude and glide ratio, and possible lateral deviation.
rhetorical job: Turn physical narrative into a traceable joint impact-location distribution rather than asserting a search region.

analytical job: Define a decreasing quadratic casualty-distance density; compute radar horizon; translate by Gh; model cross-track position normally with sigma_x=Gh sin(pi/8); multiply independent marginals.
output: A bounded along-track and normal cross-track joint density f(x,Y_I).
handoff: Discretization integrates this continuous density into region-level probabilities of containment.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The joint density, three-sigma cross-track support, search-plane speed, and a half-hour cell traversal target.
rhetorical job: Make a continuous location prior actionable as a finite matrix with a time interpretation.
analytical job: Bound x at three standard deviations; choose N by along-track span divided by 0.5 v_s; divide into N by 6 cells; exploit symmetry; integrate each cell in Mathematica.
output: A source-ordered list of POC values assigned to an N by 6 search-region matrix.
handoff: Coordinate transformation converts each selected cell from IFP-relative miles to latitude and longitude.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: Integer cell indices, sigma_x, the along-track partition, y0 and yB in local and geographic systems, and the flight-vector components.
rhetorical job: Close the gap between a mathematical grid and coordinates a search-and-rescue team can receive.
analytical job: Assemble corner matrix C; infer orientation phi; choose the sign-specific rotation R; check det(R)=1; scale and translate to C_L.
output: Latitude-longitude coordinates for every bounding corner of a selected region.
handoff: POD next quantifies whether search assets can detect the target while traversing such a region.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: One cell's area, effective detection distance, search altitude, condition factor, swept distance, synchronized aircraft count, and parallel-swath geometry.
rhetorical job: Retain containment and detection as separate probabilities and make resource/scenario changes enter through named parameters.
analytical job: Adapt Koopman's exponential; compute A_S, projected detection reach, sweep width S, distance per swath d_s, effort d_s n, and final POD.
output: A region-level POD that can be uniform when search effort does not vary by region.
handoff: Nondetection uses POD to update the searched region's POC.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: An N by 6 POC matrix, region-specific POD, the just-searched cell, and its adjacent neighbors.
rhetorical job: Connect imperfect sensing to the next operational action rather than treating one unsuccessful pass as elimination.
analytical job: Retain POC_q(1-POD_q) in the searched cell; spread removed mass across other cells; compare updated adjacent POCs; choose the highest neighbor to reduce nonadjacent travel.
output: An iterative POC map and local next-region sequence that permits later revisits.
handoff: The assumption list defines when the distribution, detector, and path sequence are intended to apply.

main_argument_chains.claim: Last communication, radar horizon, glide, and cross-track deviation turn sparse flight evidence into a bounded joint containment field.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: represent the unknown aircraft location as a bounded, source-parameterized probability field

main_argument_chains.claim: Timed discretization and an explicit coordinate transform turn the continuous field into search-region probabilities and geographic corners.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: hand search teams finite probability cells with operational bounds

main_argument_chains.claim: A resource-parameterized detector and miss update connect imperfect sensing to a travel-aware neighboring-cell sequence with revisits.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: let imperfect detection change a travel-aware local search sequence

main_argument_chains.claim: Sensitivity and Flight ABCD show how incident and fleet parameters propagate through 36 POC cells, POD, two route variants, and an operational recommendation.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: recommend the neighborhood method only with incident-specific parameters and sufficient search resources

main_argument_chains.claim: Strength/limit boundaries, the press summary, references, and appendices carry the model to public action while exposing unresolved evidence and execution gaps.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: communicate the method from typed evidence while preserving restrictions and provenance gaps

warnings.warning: The printed CDF derivation retains squared terms and dy_C in its alleged antiderivative. Preserve the source form as evidence only and re-derive the integral before numeric reuse.
The translated impact variable Y_I=Y_C+Gh should shift both support limits, but the printed upper support remains y_B-y_R rather than y_B-y_R+Gh.
The joint density inherits the impact-density support inconsistency, so its normalization and every downstream regional integral require a corrected support audit.
The printed indexed x inequality is not an unambiguous lower-and-upper cell-bound contract; the role and sign of l must be made explicit before generating corners.
The printed y bound uses y_B-y_0-Gh and does not clearly preserve the earlier radar-horizon and impact-support terms, creating a geometry mismatch between density, partition, and coordinates.
rho is described as miles per degree but is multiplied in C_L=rho R C+y_0. A miles-to-degrees transform normally requires the reciprocal convention, so units and direction must be reconciled.

Multiplying the searched-cell POC by 1-POD is a likelihood step, but the subsequent uniform mass redistribution is a mass-conserving heuristic rather than a normalized Bayesian posterior conditioned on nondetection.
Flight ABCD's numerical impact-density center and support do not transparently follow the general Y_I=Y_C+Gh translation, and no normalization or substitution audit is shown.
The methodology defines the condition factor as kappa, but the worked-example and Appendix C POD expression use k; the executable code must bind one symbol explicitly.
Appendix A integrates y_I from zero-based partition bounds and does not visibly add the Gh offset used by the impact variable, so its 36 POC values may not represent the declared density support.
Appendices C and D apply Ceiling to a probability-matrix redistribution term. Integer rounding is incompatible with fractional POC conservation and may collapse or inflate the update.

visualization_dispositions.analytical_purpose: Explain the physical construction of sigma_x before the normal cross-track density is introduced.
Make the three positive and three negative sigma bands and N along-track partitions inspectable.
Define the local axes and integer cell references used by the latitude-longitude transform.
Show the one-at-a-time response of the density expression to glide/deviation parameters.
Show how wider assumed off-course dispersion changes detection through cell area.
Show the detector response to a larger glide ratio and therefore larger search geometry.
Expose the search-altitude effect and the effective-range feasibility boundary.
Show the resource response to synchronized search-plane count.
Visualize the instantiated cross-track and along-track containment field before cell integration.
Show how the continuous joint density becomes 36 regional containment probabilities.
Make region identity and relative POC available to the update/path algorithm.
Show the adjacency-constrained sequence generated after repeated miss-driven POC updates.
Provide the comparator needed to explain the neighborhood restriction's travel rationale.
Retain the numerical cell masses consumed by the POC update loops rather than only the rendered surface.
Deliver one model-selected cell in operational geographic coordinates.
Expose the route, scale, corner, and rotation inputs behind the coordinate result.
Expose the numeric multiplication and translation path behind the page-23 corner coordinates.
